title.text: Ready to build your perfect form?

faqList.body: Event registration software helps organizers create online registration forms, manage attendees, collect payments, and automate event communication from one platform. It simplifies event planning by handling signups, confirmations, reminders, and attendee tracking efficiently.

faqList.header: How does event registration software work?
faqList.body: Event registration software allows you to create branded registration forms for events. When attendees sign up, their data is stored automatically, confirmations are sent, and payments can be processed. It also helps track registrations and manage event workflows in one place.

faqList.header: Can I collect payments with event registration software?
faqList.body: Yes. You can collect payments for tickets, bookings, and event fees directly through event registration forms. Formester allows secure payment collection and automates confirmations after successful transactions.

faqList.header: Is Formester free event registration software?
faqList.body: Formester offers a free plan that allows you to create event registration forms and manage attendees with essential features. You can upgrade anytime for advanced automation, integrations, and higher usage limits.

faqList.header: Can I create custom event registration forms for different events?
faqList.body: Yes. You can fully customize event registration forms with your branding, fields, logic, and workflows. Formester allows you to create forms for conferences, webinars, workshops, corporate events, and more without coding.

faqList.header: Can I manage multiple events with one platform?
faqList.body: Yes. You can manage multiple events, track registrations, and monitor attendee data from one dashboard. This makes it easy to handle recurring events, webinars, workshops, and large conferences efficiently.

faqList.header: Why should I use online event registration software instead of manual registration?
faqList.body: Online event registration software saves time by automating registrations, payments, confirmations, and attendee tracking. It reduces manual work, improves data accuracy, and provides better insights to manage and grow your events.
